_purpose: Registry of load-bearing numbers cited in docs. tools/count_truth.py recomputes each value from its authoritative source and fails when a cited file no longer states the current value. The checker NEVER edits docs - drift is fixed by a human doc edit. STATED LIMIT (measured phase 43): a claim asserts that a cited file states the current value SOMEWHERE, not that every restatement in that file agrees. A doc carrying the same number twice stays green if one copy drifts. That is deliberate — several docs restate a historical figure beside the current one on purpose (e.g. the phase-38 correction narrative) — but it means count_truth is a floor, not a proof of internal consistency. Phase 50: a claim may opt into every-occurrence checking with "context_patterns" (one capture group per regex; every match must equal the current value) — enabled for feeds_count, horizon_count, stig_benchmarks and stig_rules.

horizon_count._purpose: Number of anticipated_updates.json records. Phase 50: every-occurrence mode — each context_patterns match in a cited file must equal the current value, so a stale second restatement (README.md carried 77 and a stale 76 for phases 47-49) now fails.

schema_version._purpose: The schema version restated in each cited doc. context_patterns (phase 53) name the CURRENT-version statement of each doc: bump_schema rewrites only those spans and count_truth holds every match equal to the current version. Any other mention is history (a phase row recording the schema that phase shipped) and is never rewritten — the 3.18 -> 3.19 bump rewrote STATE's phase-40 row because the old rule replaced every occurrence.

version_current._purpose: The release version stated in VERSION must equal the latest changes/CHANGELOG.md heading. Registered in phase 46 after phase 45 shipped 0.12.1 in the changelog while VERSION stayed 0.12.0 with nothing watching.
